_about: Numbers read by scripts/maildomain.py. The first three are from mail standards and were written from memory, so they are unverified until someone reads the section named. The last two are mstack working values with no standard behind them.

spf_max_lookups.unit: DNS-querying terms (include, a, mx, ptr, exists, redirect) allowed while evaluating one SPF record

dkim_min_rsa_bits.unit: bits; a shorter RSA key fails

dkim_recommended_rsa_bits.unit: bits; a shorter RSA key gets a warning

spf_ip4_prefix_fail.unit: prefix length; an ip4 range wider than this (a smaller number) fails as too permissive
spf_ip4_prefix_fail.source: mstack working value, not from a standard

spf_ip4_prefix_warn.unit: prefix length; an ip4 range wider than this gets a warning
spf_ip4_prefix_warn.source: mstack working value, not from a standard
